title: Claimed 'telegram' negative-control bite-test for the widened channel CHECK does not exist anywhere in server/ or supabase/
evidence:
Briefing: "The minion claims the em-dash→period fix + a migration bite-test ('web' ✓ / 'telegram' ✗)."
Migration: "  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS reference_objection_log_channel_check,
  ADD CONSTRAINT reference_objection_log_channel_check
    CHECK (channel IN ('form','sms','email','web'));"
Only positive half exists: server/test/integration/reference_exit_routes_integration_test.gleam:296 "|> should.equal("web")". `grep -rn "telegram" server/ supabase/` returns zero matches in every test file.
detail: The 'web' ✓ assertion exists (stop_post_objects_and_writes_evidence_once_test), but the claimed 'telegram' ✗ negative control was never shipped. The widened CHECK has no test proving the constraint still bites.
recommended_fix: Add a negative control: attempt INSERT into reference_objection_log with channel 'telegram' and assert the constraint violation, or drop the claim from the completion notes.

True -> form_pages.view_decline_confirmed()".
